create_Optim_instance: create an Optim wrapper for a PyTorch model with a specified optimizer class and gradient clipping
run_Optim_step: run an optimizer step with optional gradient norm clipping and statistics tracking
test_Optim_assert_zero_grad: test that all model parameter gradients sum to zero using assert_zero_grad
refactor_Optim_zero_grad: refactor the Optim class to call zero_grad on the underlying optimizer
review_Optim_class: review the Optim wrapper class and its gradient clipping and step methods
